\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{\global\advance\TCformatted by1\write\TCnodes{ENTRY #1}\TCname{#1}}
\makeatletter
\let\TCanchor\dte@findanchor
\def\dte@findanchor#1{\TCanchor{#1}%
  \typeout{TC-ANCHOR \the\dte@tnum:#1:\the\dte@k:\ifdte@splitflag1\else0\fi}}
\let\TCbreak\dte@store@breaklines
\def\dte@store@breaklines#1#2{\TCbreak{#1}{#2}\typeout{TC-BREAK \the\dte@tnum:#2:#1}}
\let\TCfirst\dte@compute@availht@first
\def\dte@compute@availht@first{\typeout{TC-COLHEIGHT \the\dte@tnum:\number\@colht}\TCfirst}
\AtEndDocument{\typeout{TC-FORMATTED \the\TCformatted}}
\makeatother
